name: Character Editor
author: ct
description: Editor of the game's characters (characters_base, "Kind": "character") in the style of the other editor windows: heroes, NPCs and enemies of a writable mod in a searchable list with their portraits, a form with the name in every language of the mod, portrait, the RPG map charset, battle stats and the battle actions picked from the loaded ones; loot and fields of other mods stay editable as JSON. New characters, copies, deletion, undo, and a save the running game sees at once. Opens from the main menu tools, the novel editor hub and the in-game toolbar.
